mutations.name: the sh-policy read drops the run's claimed plan approvals
kills: a PR whose only guard row is ci-policy-weakened, a merge-lint entry merges with no owner gate under a console-written approval pinning that file's head blob
a PR that adds a repo skill merges with no owner gate under a console-written approval of that skill path
a PR that changes a seat's visual path merges with no owner gate under a console-written approval of that path

mutations.name: a CI-policy approval covers by path alone, ignoring the pinned blob
kills: a PR whose only guard row is ci-policy-weakened, a merge-lint entry gates at the same head when the approval pins a different blob

mutations.name: the skill-path row never consults the run's approvals
kills: a PR that adds a repo skill merges with no owner gate under a console-written approval of that skill path

mutations.name: the visual-path glob row never consults the run's approvals
kills: a PR that changes a seat's visual path merges with no owner gate under a console-written approval of that path

mutations.name: a failed head read records the file as absent at head
kills: a weakened PR whose approval pins a deleted workflow as absent gates when the deleted file's head read fails, rather than reading it as absent
